sql:
SELECT T1.driverId, COUNT(T1.resultId) AS accident_count
FROM results AS T1
JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T2.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND T1.statusId = 3
GROUP BY T1.driverId
ORDER BY accident_count DESC
LIMIT 1
